name: agent-scheduler
description: Start coding agents on a schedule: a tracked schedule file says which command runs when and how many at once; the scheduler pulls the project's agent-data branch, checks, and asks agent-runner to run one agent per due command.

scripts.build: pnpm -C ../agent-data build && pnpm -C ../skill-branches build && pnpm -C ../skill-logs build && pnpm -C ../agent-driver build && pnpm -C ../agent-runner build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C ../agent-data build && pnpm -C ../skill-branches build && pnpm -C ../skill-logs build && pnpm -C ../agent-driver build && pnpm -C ../agent-runner build && tsc --noEmit
